protocol:
1. Set up an Invitrogen E-Gel EX precast gel cassette next to an E-Gel Power Snap instrument, with labeled microcentrifuge tubes kept on ice, a white microtube rack, disposable pipette tips, and an adjustable micropipette available.

2. Using a fresh pipette tip, transfer liquid sample from a labeled chilled microcentrifuge tube into an open microcentrifuge tube, mixing by pipetting within the tube.

3. Return the prepared microcentrifuge tube to the rack or ice and repeat liquid handling with additional labeled microcentrifuge tubes kept on ice.

4. Load an aliquot of prepared liquid sample into a well of the E-Gel EX cassette using the adjustable micropipette.

5. Prepare another labeled microcentrifuge tube by pipetting liquid sample into the tube and mixing with the pipette.

6. Load the next prepared liquid sample into another well of the E-Gel EX cassette using a fresh pipette tip.

7. Continue loading prepared liquid samples into separate wells of the E-Gel EX cassette, stabilizing the cassette on the bench during pipetting.

8. Open the E-Gel Power Snap lid and place the loaded E-Gel EX cassette into the orange gel bay.

9. Close the E-Gel Power Snap lid and start the run using the front touchscreen; the instrument display shows a run countdown of approximately 09:54–09:53.
